kevin: Heads-up: I'm putting together a Next.js App Router starter that wires LlamaIndex + a tiny eval harness (seed prompts + perf metrics). Goal: zero-config for dev and one-command deploy to Vercel. Ran into a couple of DX hurdles — sharing here so we can decide which to fix in the starter vs SDK.
maria: Nice. What problems?
kevin: Short list: 1) browser/edge SDK lacks the same retry/backoff config as node SDK (can't tune 429/5xx behavior). 2) App Router + edge runtime + middleware for auth is tricky — example in the starter used middleware to inject the API key into request headers, but that breaks when deployed with Vercel preview where middleware runs separately. 3) LlamaIndex adaptor types missing in the TS defs, so the example's connector import errors for users on first npm install.
lee: Oof. For (1) we should expose a shared RetryPolicy type and default policy constant so starters can import the same shape across runtimes. For (2) maybe avoid middleware and instead show a server-only API route that proxies requests and sets idempotency.
maria: Agreed on proxy pattern. Also: add a tiny utility in the starter to assert required env vars at boot and fail-fast with a clear message. Too many users copy .env.example and hit silent auth failures.
kevin: Example of the idempotency approach I added to the PR: ```js
// app/api/generate/route.js (edge-safe)
import { v4 as uuid } from 'uuid'
export async function POST(req){
  const id = req.headers.get('x-idempotency-key') || uuid()
  const body = await req.json()
  // forward to internal worker that talks to Redwood API
  const res = await fetch(process.env.REDWOOD_API_PROXY + '/invoke', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'x-idempotency-key': id },
    body: JSON.stringify(body)
  })
  return new Response(await res.text(), { status: res.status })
}
```
lee: That looks good. For (3) about types: can you paste the TS error? We should triage whether it's a packaging mistake or truly missing exports.
kevin: Error was: "Module '.../sdk' has no exported member 'LlamaIndexConnector'". The connector exists at runtime in the package but the type exports are not included in dist/index.d.ts. I think our build step omits some files.
maria: Filing a build issue is fine, but in the starter we can add a temporary import path comment and a note: "If you see X, run npm i @types/redwood-sdk-llamaindex (temporary)". Not ideal but reduces friction.
lee: Regarding retry parity: also a security footgun — browser SDK currently retries on 401 to attempt token rotation (legacy behavior). For server starters we should recommend disabling 401 retries and handle token refresh explicitly. Small sample: ```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, retry: { attempts: 4, retryOn: [429, 502, 503, 504], retryOn401: false } })
```
kevin: Exactly. I also added an "Eval harness checklist" to the README — things like: seed prompts folder, deterministic random seed, idempotency keys enabled for server evals, lightweight telemetry toggles.
ci-bot: CI: starter-tests / e2e (flaky) failed on preview deployment: /tests/e2e/auth.spec.js:27  authentication mismatch on edge. Rerun suggests mismatch between middleware vs proxy approach. https://ci.internal/1991234567
maria: OK I'll update the starter PR: remove middleware auth example, add proxy example + idempotency snippet, add env assertion script, and bump SDK-dev dependency to include the TS export fix once it's merged.
lee: Can we also include a short note in the quickstart: "Edge runtime => prefer proxy routes for long-lived secrets; middleware runs at CDN edge and may not have same env mapping."
kevin: Adding that now to the PR description. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-starters/pull/356 (WIP)
maria: Thanks. Once SDK PR for types/RetryPolicy is up, update the starter to import the shared RetryPolicy and use it in examples so users see the same API across runtimes.
kevin: Will do. Marking this thread as action items: 1) Starter PR updates (kevin). 2) SDK issue for RetryPolicy/types (maria). 3) CI flaky test investigation (lee).
lee: I'll triage CI flakes after the starter PR lands.
kevin: Cool. Small DX wins but will save a lot of confusion for first-time users. :rocket:
